props.name: data
props.description: Ordered plan labels and monthly recurring revenue in thousands of dollars. Tone ranks available values without reordering categories; ties follow input order and ranks beyond the four-tone ramp retain its lightest tone. Null, negative and non-finite values remain unavailable in their category slot; zero retains its value label without a bar.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
